descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Seit 1993 sind wir Partner von INFOR , einem der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Unternehmenssoftware. Mit Infor LN, Cloud oder On-Premise , für kleine und große Produktionsunternehmen , bieten wir die optimale Lösung für integrierte Geschäftsprozesse, insbesondere bei ETO, MTO, MTS und Serienfertigung. Unsere smarten Erweiterungen und Schnittstellen für Infor LN gehen weit über den Standard hinaus und unterstützen unsere Kunden bei der Prozessoptimierung und der digitalen Transformation auch mit KI. Für alle, die nicht im schönen Saarland wohnen: Ein Umzug ist nicht erforderlich. Wir bieten die Stelle auch remote an. Standardmäßig ist die Ausschreibung als Vollzeitstelle im Rahmen einer 40 Stunden Woche gedacht. Wir sind aber gerne mit Ihnen gemeinsam flexibel und für eine Vielzahl von Arbeitszeitmodellen offen. Aufgaben Sie begleiten unsere Kunden ganzheitlich: bei der Neueinführung von Infor LN ebenso wie beim Technologiewechsel, zum Beispiel von on-premise in die Infor LN Cloud. Mit Deinem strategischen Blick, Deinem Verständnis für Tracking und Deiner Beratungskompetenz begleitest Du komplexe Paid-Media Projekte von der Strategie bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung. MAI ist eine starke Gruppe mit acht Agenturen verteilt auf die Standorte Hamburg, Berlin, Paderborn, Köln, Augsburg, München, Wien – verbunden durch gemeinsame Ziele, gegenseitigen Austausch und die Zusammenarbeit über Standortgrenzen hinweg. Wo Du auch bei uns startest: Du wirst Teil Deines Teams vor Ort und gleichzeitig Teil von MAI. Aufgaben Du betreust und berätst einen eigenen Kundenstamm eigenständig, digtial und persönlich, und verantwortest Strategie und Ergebnis. Du entwickelst Paid-Media-Konzepte, Marktanalysen und Account-Audits über Google Ads und Social Ads hinweg. descriptionAr: Who We Are Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together . We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. About The Role: We're looking to hire a new Talent Sourcer in Tokyo to build top-of-funnel talent pipelines and shape talent strategy across our Go-To-Market (GTM) organization. In this role, you'll partner with regional leadership to fill critical GTM roles like Solutions Consultants and Outcomes Architects primarily in Japan. What You'll Do: You'll manage the sourcing process from inception through successful close, ensuring an exceptional experience for candidates and hiring managers at every step You'll serve as a strategic advisor and talent sourcing expert, leading successful searches across GTM roles You'll conduct initial qualification screenings and casual chats with candidates to assess fit and build relationships You'll collaborate with the broader team on process improvements, programs, and strategic initiatives You'll lead talent branding initiatives, including organizing hiring webinars and publishing blogs and articles that feature our employees You'll provide talent mapping and market insights to support local and global recruiting and hiring teams You'll make informed data-driven decisions that build efficiencies into the sourcing process You'll find creative and unconventional ways to help us build a diverse top-of-funnel for GTM roles across all levels You'll help build and manage partnerships to bring more underrepresented talent to Notion You'll advance our Inclusion, Diversity, Equity, and Accessibility (I.D.E.A) strategy, working to build more diverse and inclusive teams What You'll Achieve: Manage sourcing for multiple complex and evergreen searches, creating innovative strategies and engagement to bring the best and most diverse talent to Notion Help develop and execute comprehensive sourcing plans, analyzing role requirements to define target profiles and identify qualified candidates Partner closely with other members of the Recruiting team to ensure we hit our hiring targets without sacrificing quality Collaborate closely with Hiring Managers throughout the recruiting process to ensure we meet their hiring needs and goals Establish and maintain meaningful relationships with management and key cross-functional stakeholders Skills and Toolset You'll Need to Bring: At least 3 years of experience in talent sourcing or recruitment, whether in-house or agency, or relevant transferable skills from related fields Experience using LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing tools, with skills in Boolean and AI-powered searches (or eagerness to learn these tools) Persistence, consistency, and attention to detail - if we hire one person out of 200 candidates, you'd ensure the other 199 have a great experience. You care deeply about your craft. Strong time management, prioritization, and organizational skills. You are self-motivated and committed to excellence You are kind, warm, and thoughtful - you'll represent the company when you interact with thousands of candidates each year You'll contribute across the full scope of recruiting operations, from maintaining our ATS database and finding new ways to source candidates to analyzing data to improve recruiting efficiency and managing sourcing channels Fluency in Japanese and business-level English A Note on AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. Equal Opportunity & Accommodations We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

descriptionAr: Wir sind hey contact heroes, ein Kundenservice-Dienstleister aus dem Herzen von Hamburg, im Zentrum der HafenCity. Seit 2021 betreuen wir für Marken wie Telefónica, 1&1, Universal Music, Check24, Hamburg Wasser und enviaM deren Kundinnen und Kunden am Telefon, per Mail und im Chat. Mehr als 500 Teammitglieder arbeiten bei uns europaweit remote, und in den letzten Jahren sind wir jedes Jahr um 8 bis 10 Prozent gewachsen. Für unsere Projekte suchen wir eine Person, die das Workforce Management bei uns fest in die Hand nimmt, von Forecast und Schichtplanung über die Intraday-Steuerung bis zur Automatisierung unserer Planungs- und Reportingtools. Die Stelle ist eine Vollzeitstelle, zu 100 % remote und kann von überall in Europa besetzt werden. Aufgaben Du erstellst Forecasts für das Kontaktvolumen, leitest daraus den Personalbedarf ab und baust bedarfsgerechte Einsatz- und Schichtpläne mit sinnvollen Schichtrotationen, abgestimmt auf Verfügbarkeiten, Qualifikationen und Skills. Im Tagesgeschäft hast du Servicelevel, Erreichbarkeit, Produktivität und Auslastung im Blick und steuerst intraday nach, wenn es nötig ist. Du planst den Personaleinsatz über mehrere Projekte und Skills hinweg, auch im Blending, und achtest auf Schichttreue und die Einhaltung geplanter Arbeitszeiten. Du analysierst unsere WFM- und Performancekennzahlen, vergleichst Forecast und tatsächliches Aufkommen und leitest daraus konkrete Verbesserungen ab. Genauso wichtig ist die technische Seite. Du entwickelst unsere serverbasierten Planungs- und Schichtplanungstools weiter, passt Planungslogiken, Kapazitätssteuerung und Buchungsprozesse an und automatisierst Reportings, vor allem mit Google Apps Script, Google Sheets und Datenschnittstellen. Du pflegst und verbesserst unsere automatisierten Abrechnungs- und Controllingtools, betreust Datenimporte und Schnittstellen und sorgst dafür, dass die Daten stimmen. Wo heute noch viel von Hand läuft, findest du einen Weg, es zu automatisieren. Qualifikation Du hast mehrere Jahre Erfahrung im Workforce Management, idealerweise im Contact Center oder Kundenservice, und kennst Forecasting, Schichtplanung und Intraday-Steuerung aus der Praxis. Kennzahlen wie Servicelevel, Erreichbarkeit, AHT, Auslastung und Schichttreue sind für dich Alltag. Du bist technisch fit. Google Sheets beherrschst du richtig gut, mit Google Apps Script oder JavaScript hast du schon eigene Lösungen gebaut, und Datenschnittstellen, Importe und SQL schrecken dich nicht ab. Erfahrung mit WFM-Software oder Dialersystemen ist ein Plus. Du arbeitest strukturiert und zuverlässig, behältst auch an hektischen Tagen den Überblick und stimmst dich gut mit Projekt- und Teamleitungen ab. Deutsch sprichst du auf muttersprachlichem Niveau oder mindestens auf C1/C2. Benefits Du arbeitest in Vollzeit und zu 100 % remote, egal wo in Europa du lebst. Du bekommst eine Rolle mit echtem Einfluss, denn deine Planung entscheidet jeden Tag mit darüber, wie gut unsere Projekte laufen. Du hast viel Freiraum, unsere Tools und Abläufe weiterzuentwickeln, kurze Wege und schnelle Entscheidungen. Dazu kommt ein Team, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt, und ein Arbeitgeber, der wächst. Klingt nach dir? Dann bewirb dich direkt hier über JOIN mit deinem Lebenslauf und gern ein paar Sätzen dazu, welche Planungen, Steuerungen oder Automatisierungen du schon umgesetzt hast. Alles Weitere zu Vertrag und Vergütung besprechen wir gemeinsam im ersten Gespräch. Wir freuen uns auf dich! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: Lisbon, Portugal  Role Summary Cloudflare MCP Server Portals give organizations a secure, centralized way to connect AI agents to internal and third-party tools. As a Senior Systems Engineer on the MCP Portals team, you will lead the design, delivery, and operation of distributed systems that authenticate users, manage OAuth credentials and sessions, enforce Zero Trust policies, and proxy MCP traffic across Cloudflare's global network. You will own complex projects across service boundaries, make architectural tradeoffs for your area, and help other engineers deliver reliable, secure changes. You will work closely with engineers and product managers across Access, Gateway, and Developer Platform teams as the protocol and product evolve. We are looking for a hands-on engineer who can bring clarity to ambiguous systems problems and take responsibility for outcomes in production.   Role Responsibilities Lead the design, implementation, and operation of globally distributed services that connect MCP clients to authorized upstream MCP servers. Own complex features and service improvements from problem definition and design through implementation, rollout, observability, and production support. Shape technical decisions for MCP Portals, including service boundaries, security controls, compatibility, and tradeoffs among reliability, latency, and resource use. Evolve our implementation as the MCP specification changes, planning safe migrations for existing customers and integrations. Design and review authentication and authorization flows involving Cloudflare Access, OAuth, identity, credential handling, and delegated access to upstream services. Improve the reliability and scalability of multi-tenant systems built on the Cloudflare Developer Platform, using production data to identify and prioritize work. Strengthen observability through structured logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and actionable alerts; participate in production support and incident response. Lead investigations of complex customer issues across services and teams, identify root causes, and drive fixes that prevent recurrence. Review designs and code, mentor engineers, and raise the quality of testing, deployment, and operational practices on the team. Partner with product, security, and engineering teams to turn customer needs and emerging standards into maintainable product capabilities.   Role Requirements Must Have Skills 6+ years of experience building and operating distributed systems, backend services, network services, or infrastructure products in production. Demonstrated ownership of complex production services or projects, including architecture, implementation, rollout, and operational outcomes. Strong programming skills in TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, Rust, C++, or another language used to build production services. Deep understanding of HTTP, APIs, proxies, streaming connections, and distributed-systems failure modes. Experience with authentication and authorization technologies such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWTs, PKCE, or policy-based access control. Experience designing or operating security-sensitive systems, with sound judgment about identity, authorization, credential handling, concurrency, and state management. Ability to diagnose difficult production issues using logs, metrics, traces, error reporting, and customer-provided evidence, then drive durable fixes. Experience making backward-compatible changes to live systems and managing the risks of deployment and migration. Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs, influence decisions across teams, and mentor other engineers. Applicants should provide a resume or CV describing relevant engineering, technical leadership, and operational experience. Nice to Have Skills Experience with the Model Context Protocol  Familiarity with the Cloudflare Developer Platform or other serverless edge-computing platforms. Experience building gateways, forward proxies, identity systems, developer platforms, or Zero Trust and data loss prevention products. Compensation Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary of €66,000-91,000  Equity This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan. What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company.

Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We're strong proponents of a consultative sales approach - learn about the customer's needs first before talking about our products. Your expertise will be critical in helping articulate the value of our products.  What You’ll Be Doing Identify new opportunities to expand Grafana usage within a set of current customers Meet and exceed individual quarterly and annual sales goals Manage all aspects of the sales process (prospecting, sales meetings, product demos, proofs of concept, proposals, negotiations and account management) Cultivate sales through outbound prospecting and inbound leads Be able to understand and convey the value of both Grafana Cloud and Grafana Enterprise Become an expert in managing your sales pipeline in Salesforce Manage quote creation, order processing, and day-to-day customer requests What Makes You a Great Fit: 2+ Years of experience in infrastructure technology sales Demonstrated history of consistent goal achievement in a highly competitive environment (top 10% performer) Energetic, upbeat, entrepreneurial, tenacious team player Adaptable and with demonstrable experience in high velocity technology companies You will need to be an excellent communicator in all channels (in person, online, in writing) and able to form strong working relationships both in person and virtually Fluent in English & French (both spoken & written).    Bonus Points For:   Familiarity with open source technology is a significant advantage Experience using Salesforce Experience using Command of the Message and MEDD(P)ICC is ideal Compensation & Reward  In France, the OTE compensation range for this role is EUR 144,250 - EUR 180,250 .   Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. *Compensation ranges are country specific. Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work. In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.  Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable. descriptionAr: About the team The Applied AI Engineering (Codex) team helps customers adopt OpenAI's coding tools throughout their software development lifecycle. We act as trusted technical partners, guiding engineering teams as they integrate Codex into their projects and workflows. Our customers span digital-native companies to global enterprises, and we work side-by-side to accelerate how they plan, build, and deliver software. About the Role We are seeking a technically deep, creativity-driven Applied AI Engineer who is already a power user of AI coding tools and passionate about pushing the boundaries of developer productivity. You will partner directly with engineering leaders and hands-on builders to design, validate, and scale advanced AI workflows, often using Codex to prototype and build the very demos, integrations, and automations customers ultimately adopt. This is a highly cross-functional role that blends technical architecture, product strategy, and customer-facing leadership. You’ll work closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Applied Engineering, and the broader Codex organization to advocate for customer needs, shape product direction, and accelerate the successful deployment of intelligent coding systems across some of the world’s most influential companies. This role is based in Singapore. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees In this role, you will: Serve as the primary technical subject matter expert on OpenAI Codex for a portfolio of customers, embedding deeply with them to enable their engineering teams and build coding workflows. Partner directly with customers to design and implement AI-enhanced development workflows, from rapid prototyping through scalable production rollout. Build high-quality demos, reference implementations, and workflow automations, using Codex itself as part of your development process. Lead large-format workshops, technical deep dives, and hands-on enablement sessions that help engineering organizations adopt AI coding tools effectively and safely. Contribute technical content including examples, guides, patterns, and best practices to the OpenAI Cookbook to help the broader developer community accelerate their work with Codex. Gather high-fidelity product insights from real customer deployments and translate them into clear product proposals and model feedback for internal teams. Influence customer strategy and decision-making by framing how AI coding tools fit into their SDLC, technical roadmap, and organizational workflows. Serve as a trusted advisor on solution architecture, operational readiness, model configuration, security considerations, and best-practice adoption. You’ll thrive in this role if you: Ability to speak Mandarin is a requirement as you will be working with Mandarin-speaking customers and/or vendors in the role. Have 5+ years of technical consulting, post-sales engineering, solutions architecture, or similar experience working directly with customers. Are an active power user of AI coding tools and have deeply customized your own developer workflow; you have a point of view on what makes engineers more productive. Enjoy building scrappy, high-signal demos, integrations, and prototypes that clearly articulate what Codex can enable, often using Codex to accelerate your own development process. Have experience delivering large, high-impact workshops or technical training to engineering teams and know how to craft sessions that are engaging, hands-on, and outcomes-driven. Have contributed technical guides, patterns, or examples publicly and care about clarity, pedagogy, and community impact. Communicate complex technical concepts in clear, persuasive written and verbal form especially when helping customers make strategic decisions about where and how to apply AI. Are excited by ambiguous, rapidly evolving problem spaces and enjoy iterating toward novel solutions hand-in-hand with customers. Care about customer success, reliability, safety, and operational excellence as much as you care about technical ingenuity. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement . Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. We have recently reached an important milestone of 1B+ downloads worldwide , moving closer to our mission of supporting people on their self-improvement journeys. Our mission is to become a stepping stone on our customers’ journeys of self-improvement. About the project At Radiotech , we believe music belongs to everyone - not just those who grew up taking lessons. As a product company inside the Gismart ecosystem, we've spent years building apps that make music feel approachable, fun, and deeply human. With 23 apps across iOS and Android and over 500 million downloads worldwide, our products have found their way into the hands of musicians, beginners, and curious souls across the globe. We see music as a universal language. Our job is to make sure more people can speak it. Responsibilities Develop, maintain, and modernize existing iOS applications using Swift, SwiftUI, and UIKit. Define and evolve the architecture of the iOS codebase with a focus on scalability, modularization, and maintainability. Design and implement efficient, testable technical solutions. Prepare existing applications for gradual adoption of Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP). Participate in the migration of selected business logic and shared components to KMP. Collaborate with Android and other engineers on shared mobile architecture and APIs. Research technical challenges and propose appropriate architectural solutions. Troubleshoot complex issues and optimize application performance and memory usage. Perform code reviews and contribute to technical documentation. Maintain and improve CI/CD and release workflows. Collaborate with Product Managers on technical solutions, planning, and estimation. Proactively suggest technical and product improvements. Use AI coding tools and engineering agents such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or similar as part of the regular development workflow. Requirements 4+ years of professional iOS development experience. Strong proficiency in Swift and modern language features. Strong experience with Swift Concurrency (async/await) and reactive programming such as Combine. Production experience with both SwiftUI and UIKit. Strong understanding of iOS architecture, application lifecycle, and platform frameworks. Experience with MVVM, Clean Architecture, modular architecture, and reusable components. Ability to independently design and implement complex technical solutions. Experience with REST APIs, GraphQL, asynchronous networking, and multithreading. Familiarity with Xcode, Instruments, SPM, CocoaPods, and Fastlane. Understanding of App Store submission, signing, provisioning, TestFlight, and release management. Experience with feature flags, remote configuration, and A/B testing. Experience with CI/CD and automated testing. Practical experience using AI coding assistants and engineering agents in daily development. Employee Benefits Remote-First Culture: Our team is diverse and extensive, just like our product portfolio. We provide a flexible working schedule and let you work anywhere in the world, either remotely or in one of our corporate hubs. Сoworking Compensation: We provide 100% compensation for coworking spaces in Ukraine (except Kyiv, where we have a cozy and autonomous hub) and 50% compensation for coworking spaces worldwide to make sure that everyone has a comfortable and inspiring workspace. Free Office Lunches: We want you to stay fueled and focused, so we provide delicious free lunches for everyone working from our hubs. It’s one less thing for you to worry about during a productive workday. Public Holidays Policy: Gismart observes public holidays based on the Ukrainian or Polish holiday calendars. Employees working in other locations are entitled to 12 public holidays per year. 100% Sick Leave Compensation Mental and Physical Health: To help you stay happy and healthy, Gismart will partially cover your medical insurance, sports activities, therapy costs. Personal Equipment Policy: Of course, we’ll provide you with all the equipment you need or cover the maintenance cost for your own tools. Personal Learning and Development: We love to see you learn and grow, so Gismart will cover 70% of your professional development courses. We’ll also pay for 100% of corporate English courses. Time-Off Policy: Every employee gets 18 working days of paid vacation and 3 personal days per year, with an extra day added for each year at Gismart. Corporate Events: We are remote-first, but we love meeting up in person. Whenever possible, we organize corporate events and team-building activities across all Gismart hubs. You will own accounting and close activities across assigned balance sheet and P&L areas, manage intercompany activity for assigned entities, and build efficient, well-controlled processes. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with responsibility for independently managing accounting processes, exercising sound judgment, and reviewing work performed by outsourced partners. You will partner closely with Tax, Treasury, Strategic Finance, and Business Systems to resolve issues, support business growth, and improve how we work. This role is based in San Francisco, CA . We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. Prepare and review journal entries, account reconciliations, and supporting schedules; resolve accounting issues and maintain clear, audit-ready documentation. Manage intercompany accounting for assigned entities, including cross-charges, reconciliations, and coordination of settlements. Investigate differences and drive timely resolution with counterparties. Support consolidation activities, including intercompany eliminations, entity-level validations, and foreign currency accounting, in partnership with the consolidation lead. Analyze balance sheet and P&L movements, develop clear flux commentary, and partner with Strategic Finance to explain business drivers and variances. Coordinate and review work performed by outsourced accounting partners, setting expectations for quality, timeliness, and issue escalation. Own and improve internal controls within assigned processes, maintain process documentation, and support external audits. Drive process improvements and automation, partnering with Business Systems to improve Oracle workflows, strengthen data quality, and reduce manual work through tools and AI-enabled solutions. Support new entities, acquisitions, and business initiatives by establishing accounting workflows and integrating them into the close. You might thrive in this role if you have: 6+ years of progressive accounting experience, with demonstrated ownership of close processes and experience reviewing others’ work or managing in outsourced support. A strong general accounting foundation and practical knowledge of U.S. GAAP, including accruals, reconciliations, and financial statement analysis. Hands-on intercompany accounting experience, including recording transactions, reconciling balances, and resolving differences across entities. The judgment to independently resolve routine and moderately complex accounting issues, identify risks, and escalate matters with clear recommendations. Experience operating and improving internal controls and supporting financial statement audits. Proficiency with ERP systems and advanced Excel skills; Oracle Fusion experience is preferred, and exposure to Oracle FCCS or another consolidation system is a plus. A track record of improving accounting processes, with curiosity about automation and AI tools. Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to manage competing deadlines and work effectively across teams. CPA qualification and/or public accounting experience is preferred. descriptionAr: About the Team OpenAI’s Real Estate & Workplace (REW) team creates and operates the spaces that support our people and our mission. Within REW, the Strategic Occupancy Planning team connects business needs, workplace strategy, and space data to help shape where and how our teams work. We partner closely with business leaders, Finance, People, Workplace Operations, and Design & Construction to anticipate growth, optimize space utilization, and deliver a thoughtful, scalable workplace experience. About the Role We’re looking for an experienced Occupancy Planning & Workplace Strategy Manager to lead strategic space planning for our Go-to-Market (GTM) and General & Administrative (G&A) organizations. In this role, you’ll translate evolving business needs into actionable occupancy strategies, capacity scenarios, and workplace recommendations. You’ll serve as a trusted partner to business leaders, balancing growth projections, operational requirements, and employee experience to inform decisions about how our teams use space. You’ll own planning across a complex, evolving portfolio while leveraging CAFM/IWMS systems and data analytics to drive accurate, scalable decision-making. This role requires a combination of strategic thinking, hands-on technical expertise, and strong cross-functional partnership to turn planning recommendations into operational outcomes. This role is based in San Francisco. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week, with approximately 10–20% travel. In This Role, You Will Own strategic occupancy planning for GTM and G&A organizations, translating headcount forecasts, business priorities, and workplace needs into actionable space plans. Develop and evaluate capacity scenarios, neighborhood strategies, team adjacencies, seating models, and space allocation recommendations to support organizational growth. Partner with business leaders and executive stakeholders to understand evolving requirements, communicate trade-offs, and align workplace strategies with business objectives. Collaborate with Finance, People, Analytics, Design & Construction, and Workplace Operations to reconcile forecasts, assess capacity constraints, and guide planning decisions through implementation. Translate workplace needs into practical stacking, blocking, and move plans, ensuring recommendations account for operational feasibility, timing, and employee experience. Leverage CAFM/IWMS platforms and analytical tools to maintain accurate space inventories, floor plans, seating allocations, and utilization data. Identify and resolve space data discrepancies, establish quality controls, and partner with internal system owners and external vendors to improve data reliability. Develop dashboards, planning workflows, and reporting tools that improve visibility into occupancy trends, capacity risks, and portfolio performance. Drive continuous improvement in occupancy planning processes, including opportunities for automation, system enhancements, and scalable planning practices. Support workplace change initiatives by partnering with cross-functional teams to ensure clear communication, coordinated execution, and successful transitions. You Might Thrive in This Role If You Bring 5–8+ years of experience in occupancy planning, workplace strategy, space management, or a related field, with experience independently managing complex, multi-team or multi-site portfolios. Have a strong track record of translating business growth, headcount projections, and workplace requirements into practical, data-informed space strategies. Possess hands-on experience with CAFM/IWMS platforms, including space inventory management, floor plans, seating allocations, data reconciliation, and reporting. Are highly analytical and comfortable developing scenarios, evaluating trade-offs, and translating complex data into clear recommendations for senior stakeholders. Excel at building trusted relationships with business leaders and cross-functional partners, influencing decisions without direct authority. Can balance long-term strategic planning with hands-on execution in a fast-paced environment where priorities and requirements evolve quickly. Have experience supporting workplace transitions, flexible seating strategies, organizational growth, or large-scale space planning initiatives. Communicate clearly and effectively, whether presenting recommendations to executives, documenting planning assumptions, or coordinating implementation across teams. Are comfortable navigating ambiguity, identifying opportunities for process improvement, and building scalable solutions. Experience with OfficeSpace or comparable CAFM/IWMS platforms, CAD or floor-plan tools, business intelligence platforms, system migrations, and vendor management is a plus. descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: Austin, TX About the Role Cloudflare’s Emerging Technologies & Incubation team builds and launches bold new products on Cloudflare’s edge network. This role is on the Durable Objects team, which powers stateful serverless applications for Cloudflare customers. You’ll help evolve the runtime and the low-level routing and storage systems that support real-time chat, multiplayer games, AI agents, and other stateful workloads at scale. Responsibilities Build and improve the Durable Objects runtime. Design and develop the low-level routing and storage systems that power customer applications. descriptionAr: About Ramp Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. You will set the operating rhythm for complex pre-sales work, coach the team on discovery, solution design, demos, technical deal strategy, and partner closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Account Management to deliver a cohesive customer experience. You will remain close to high-impact opportunities while scaling the team’s technical ownership financial fluency, and executive presence. This is a player-coach leadership role: you will improve how the team qualifies and advances complex opportunities, create repeatable practices and assets, and use customer insight to shape Ramp’s go-to-market and product priorities. What You'll Do Lead, coach, and develop a team of Enterprise Solutions Consultants; set clear expectations, provide regular feedback, and support career growth. Establish a high-quality operating cadence for pipeline reviews, deal strategy, forecasting, staffing, and performance management. Partner with Enterprise Sales leadership to shape account strategy, qualify complex opportunities, and deploy the right solutions resources at the right moments. Coach the team to lead discovery, deliver tailored demos, and architect solutions that connect Ramp’s platform, financial workflows, ERP systems, and integrations to customer priorities. Engage directly in the most strategic or complex customer situations, including executive conversations, technical validation, RFPs, and escalations. Build scalable playbooks, technical assets, demo standards, and knowledge-sharing practices that improve quality and consistency across the team. Partner with Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Customer Success, and Services to translate recurring customer needs into actionable feedback, roadmap context, and strong handoffs. Define and inspect team health metrics such as coverage, conversion, cycle efficiency, solution quality, customer outcomes, and talent development. Foster an inclusive, high-accountability culture grounded in customer empathy, strong collaboration, speed, and continuous improvement. Identify practical ways for the team to use AI to improve preparation, documentation, solutioning, and customer-facing work while maintaining quality and good judgment. What You Need 8+ years of experience in Solutions Consulting, Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Professional Services, or a related customer-facing technical role, including 3+ years of people management or demonstrated player-coach leadership. Proven success leading teams through complex enterprise sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, technical requirements, and long decision processes. Strong understanding of enterprise financial operations, controllership priorities, and accounting workflows. Working fluency with enterprise systems and integrations, including ERP platforms such as NetSuite, Sage Intacct, or Microsoft Dynamics; APIs; SFTP; and adjacent HRIS, identity, and security systems. Demonstrated ability to coach others on discovery, solution design, executive storytelling, technical communication, and consultative selling. Strong operating judgment: able to prioritize limited resources, inspect pipeline health, make trade-offs, and drive execution in a fast-moving environment. Executive presence and ability to influence senior internal and external stakeholders by translating technical complexity into business value. Track record of building repeatable processes, assets, and team rituals that elevate performance beyond individual contributions. Experience building AI-assisted workflows for solutions, sales, or customer-facing teams. Excellent communication, organizational, and change-management skills. Nice to Have Experience supporting fintech, spend management, accounting automation, or other financial software products. Familiarity with government or public-sector selling. Familiarity with Python, Java, or SQL; data integration and ETL platforms; cloud infrastructure; or enterprise authentication and security protocols. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world. Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater. About the Team The Deployed Engineering team works directly with companies building and running AI agents in production, helping turn ideas and prototypes into systems teams can rely on. This is a hands-on, highly technical team that partners closely with customer engineers across the full lifecycle, from pre-sales evaluations to post-deployment advisory work. The focus is on achieving the technical win, co-designing agent architectures, and helping customers operate agents reliably at scale using the LangChain suite. Deployed Engineers sit at the intersection of engineering, product, and go-to-market , shaping how LangChain is adopted in the field and feeding real-world insights back into the platform. About the Role The Deployed Engineer…You’ll work on some of the hardest problems in applied AI — not demos, not research, but systems that real teams depend on in production . The feedback loop is fast, the impact is visible, and the work you do directly shapes how AI agents are built in the real world. descriptionAr: Who We Are Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together . We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. About the Role: The People Team at Notion exists to help build a generational company - one that enables people to do their best and most meaningful work. Hiring exceptional talent, at the right time and with care, is central to that mission. We’re looking for a Recruiting Coordinator to partner closely with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to create a thoughtful, well-run, and genuinely human candidate experience. This role sits at the center of our hiring process and plays an important role in how candidates experience Notion. This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. What You'll Achieve: Create a candidate experience that reflects Notion You’ll be one of the first and most consistent touchpoints candidates have with Notion. From scheduling interviews to answering questions and resolving issues, you’ll help ensure every interaction feels organized, respectful, and intentional. You’ll collaborate closely with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to continually refine our processes—so candidates leave feeling excited about what we’re building, regardless of the outcome. Coordinate interviews with care and precision You’ll manage and schedule a high volume of interviews across primarily non-technical roles, balancing speed with attention to detail. You’ll anticipate needs, communicate clearly, and keep candidates and interviewers aligned - making the process feel smooth and predictable, even as things move quickly. descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: Austin, Lisbon, or London (Hybrid) About the Role Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a massively successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization. The Workers Runtime team delivers features and improvements to our Runtime which actually executes customer code at the edge. We care deeply about increasing performance, improving JS API surface area and compiled language support through WebAssembly, and optimizing to meet the next 10x increase in scale. The Runtime is a hostile environment - system resources such as memory, cpu, I/O, etc need to be managed extremely carefully and security must be foundational in everything we do. Our work is deeply systems-oriented. We build and maintain the C++ and Rust codebase that embeds the JavaScript engine, manages isolate lifecycles, enforces resource limits (CPU, memory, I/O), and orchestrates how customer scripts are loaded, cached, and executed. We operate in a hostile multi-tenant environment where security must be foundational — from side-channel attack mitigations to isolate sandboxing — and performance is measured in microseconds. Responsibilities You will lead the Workers Runtime - Edge team, owning the runtime service in production across Cloudflare’s fleet and driving the architectural evolution of the platform. Lead a team of senior systems engineers working in C++ and Rust on one of Cloudflare’s most performance-critical and security-sensitive services. Drive major infrastructure initiatives, including migrating legacy systems, redesigning core abstractions, and laying the groundwork for next-generation runtime architecture. Own reliability and release safety for a service handling tens of millions of requests per second. Improve release processes, invest in health monitoring and automated rollback, and help the team ship changes confidently at scale. Make prioritisation calls between customer-unblocking feature work and foundational investment in security, reliability, and developer velocity. Partner closely with adjacent teams across the Developer Platform to ensure the runtime supports the broader product roadmap, including compute, storage, networking, and observability. Hire, grow, and develop strong systems engineers; set clear expectations, provide technical mentorship, and create an environment where people do their best work. Desirable Skills, Knowledge & Experience Experience leading a team. Comfortable leading and hiring a team that builds low-level distributed systems. Strong planning skills, with experience creating teams and overseeing execution to meet commitments predictably. Comfortable building developer-loved APIs that scale. Track record of leading a team through hiring, onboarding, and professional development. Ability to explain both the “why” and the “how.” Experience implementing tools, process improvements, internal instrumentation, methodologies, and resolving blockages. At least 4 years of recent professional experience with C++ or Rust. Solid understanding of computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented or functional design. Deep understanding of the web and technologies such as web browsers, HTTP, JavaScript, and WebAssembly. Strong understanding of Linux systems programming, process models, and networking. Bonus Points Experience building high-performance distributed systems. Experience working with cloud platforms, especially server-less platforms. Experience with the internals of JS engines such as V8, SpiderMonkey, or JavaScriptCore. Experience with standalone WebAssembly runtimes such as Wasmtime, Wasmer, Lucet, etc. Deep Linux/UNIX systems, kernel, or networking knowledge. Contributions to large open source projects. Experience working in low-latency real-time environments such as game streaming, game engine architecture, high-frequency trading, or payment systems. Experience debugging, optimizing, and identifying failure modes in a large-scale Linux-based distributed system. Compensation Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. ● For New Yor

An overview of this role The Trusted Agentic Development team sits within GitLab's Developer Experience group and builds the platforms our engineers rely on every day. GitLab engineers increasingly build software with artificial intelligence agents. Agents can generate code and tests in seconds, but they can also produce passing test suites for software that doesn't work as intended. As a Senior Backend Engineer, Trusted Agentic Development, you'll own the technical thesis for closing that validation gap and build the early proof yourself. You'll rethink what validation means when the author is an agent and make the feedback loop fast, automatic, and trustworthy enough that teams choose to adopt it. Validation that confirms agent-generated code does what was intended, so a passing suite means a working feature and not just a satisfied proxy. Mid-loop feedback that helps an agent self-correct toward working software instead of green assertions. Language-aware approaches under one shared model of what "trusted" means, starting with Rust, Ruby, and Go, while allowing the right technique to differ by language. Real measurement of whether engineers trust and adopt the path, fed straight back into the platform. What you’ll do Own the technical thesis for how GitLab validates software when an agent is the author, and turn it into an architecture the team can build against. Prototype the hard parts by building early versions of feedback mechanisms that catch the gap between passing tests and working software, proving what works before the team scales it. Develop approaches for GitLab's primary stacks, starting with Rust, Ruby, and Go, under one shared definition of "trusted," while allowing the right technique to differ by language. Design the mid-loop feedback an agent needs to self-correct toward working software rather than green assertions, and build the systems that deliver it. Collaborate with engineering teams to adopt these approaches, measure adoption, engineer trust, and validation quality, and use those findings to improve the platform. Set technical direction the team can build on, review designs, and help teammates grow their technical judgment. What you’ll bring Deep, current, hands-on experience building real software with artificial intelligence agents, ideally across more than one language, and a clear understanding of why agent output can pass tests yet fail in production. A strong point of view on the validation gap and concrete ideas for closing it, backed by approaches you've built or tried. Experience designing distributed systems designed to run on Kubernetes first. The technical range to design systems rather than tune a single framework, and the judgment to know when a solution should be general or language-specific. You prototype to learn, and you ship. The ability to influence engineers across an organization without formal authority through working code and sound reasoning. Strong written communication in an all-remote, asynchronous environment. Alignment with GitLab's values, especially collaboration, iteration, and transparency. This isn't a quality assurance or test automation role. We aren't looking for depth in a particular testing framework. We're looking for someone who has built with agents, experienced the validation gap firsthand, and wants to solve it. About the team The Trusted Agentic Development team is part of GitLab's Developer Experience group. We build platforms and practices that help GitLab engineers validate agent-generated software with confidence. We work across engineering teams and programming languages to understand how people use agents, test new approaches in real workflows, and create a shared model of trusted agentic development that teams choose to adopt. An overview of this role As a Senior CX Platform Engineer, you'll help GitLab's Customer Experience (CX) teams hand real work to artificial intelligence (AI). Run multiple agents in parallel on well-scoped tasks, critically review their output, and own every line that reaches production. Build and maintain the team's agent harness, including shared AGENTS.md conventions, skills, slash commands, hooks, subagent definitions, and continuous integration checks. Measure and share what works, publish reusable patterns, and retire those that don't. Strong Python skills with FastAPI or Flask and TypeScript skills with Vue or React, including application programming interface (API) design, authentication, authorization, and secure handling of customer and business data. Hands-on experience with AWS ECS, RDS, and Lambda, Terraform, Docker, and applications running behind single sign-on (SSO), such as Okta. Available Locations: Austin, TX, New York, NY, Seattle, WA   About the Role Cloudflare One brings together secure access, network connectivity, and data protection. Our products generate massive amounts of signals about how people and agents access applications, use the network, and handle data—but a security practitioner needs more than isolated events. They need to understand what happened, whether it is unusual, why it matters, and what to investigate next. The UEBA (User and Entity Behavior Analytics) team builds the systems behind those answers. We ingest and evaluate Cloudflare One signals, produce high fidelity user-risk events, maintain risk scores, and make that information available to customer-facing experiences and other Cloudflare services. Today, we are focused on expanding our behavioral detections and improving the clarity of the resulting investigations and integrations. As a Systems Engineer, you will build and operate production services in this pipeline. You might implement a detection for an unusual pattern of DNS activity or data movement, improve how events contribute to a user’s risk score, or make risk-event history easier for customers to investigate. You will own well-defined projects through design, implementation, testing, rollout, and operational follow-through, working with other engineers, Product, and partner teams across Cloudflare. Responsibilities Build behavioral detections . Turn product requirements and available telemetry into production-ready detections across signals such as Access, Gateway, DNS, device posture, and data protection. Define the data dependencies, evaluation approach, and how you will assess signal quality before release. Make risk understandable . Help connect detection output to event history, logs, and customer-facing investigations so practitioners can see what triggered a finding and how a user’s risk changed. Design & Scale Infrastructure : Architect, deploy, and maintain robust distributed systems, focusing on high availability, low latency, and horizontal scalability. Collaborate across teams . Collaborate with Product and engineers in Access, Gateway, Analytics and Reporting, Logs, and other data-producing or data-consuming teams to agree on event contracts and deliver end-to-end functionality. Ensure Reliability . Participate in architecture reviews, capacity planning, and proactive system health monitoring to guarantee maximum uptime and resilience. Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience 3+ years of professional experience building, testing, and operating backend or distributed systems in production. Strong proficiency in at least one systems programming language (e.g., Go, Rust, C/C++) with a track record of writing clean, maintainable code. 3+ years of practical experience with databases and data-intensive services—for example, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, or comparable relational or analytical stores. Experience reasoning about event-driven systems: message delivery, duplicate or late events, state, failure recovery, and safe changes to live consumers or APIs. Clear written and verbal communication, and an ability to work through technical decisions with product and engineering partners. Experience using metrics, logs, traces, profiling, and experiments to understand production behavior and validate improvements Bring strong opinions, clear judgment, and a willingness to revise your view when data, users, or production reality prove otherwise. Bonus Points Experience with security analytics, fraud or abuse detection, identity, Zero Trust, SASE, or network telemetry. Familiarity with Kafka or other streaming systems; Kubernetes; and high-volume event processing. Experience with statistical baselines, anomaly detection, time-windowed aggregation, or evaluating false positives and detection coverage. Familiarity with DNS, HTTP, authentication events, data-loss-prevention signals, or endpoint-security integrations. Experience with distributed state, caches, object storage, or safe migration of a legacy production service.   Compensation Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location and level. descriptionAr: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. The Opportunity: As a Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will focus on three core missions.  One, you will help our users and prospects navigate their Grafana journey by engaging with and listening to them in order to provide them with appropriate resources and guidance.  Two, with these learnings, you will partner with our Sales Team to connect with other influential people in these organizations to identify new business opportunities that are the pipeline for our company’s revenue goals by partnering proactively with our Sales Team. And three, you will develop valuable, transferable skills to help you achieve your career goals.  By fulfilling our three core  missions, you will contribute importantly to Grafana Labs’ community and business goals.   We understand that our commercial success is linked to our open source DNA and users’ success with our software.  As such, we want team members who can effectively leverage this connection and help support the long-term health of our company. In this role, you will balance reactive and proactive work, responding to inbound inquiries as well as outreaching to target accounts. You will need to research and have a detective mindset in order to craft thoughtful, value-add messaging; and you’ll need to be confident driving business conversations on the phone.  You will need to know how to use AI as a tool to constantly improve your productivity.  This is a demanding and rewarding role.   It is a fast-paced and challenging environment.  While our company is growing sustainably,  we still have a lot of building and improving to do.  And we do this work together with our teammates from more than 15 different countries.  We're looking for driven, humble, technically curious  people who embrace a team-first attitude and demonstrate extreme ownership.   This is a great team to join, whether you’re just starting your career or looking to pivot into the tech industry.  You’ll have managers and teammates that care deeply about you as a professional and human, and you will learn more than you thought possible. What You’ll Be Doing: Build and maintain knowledge of our technology, competitors, open source ecosystem, and industry trends Follow up on inbound leads effectively and efficiently Use a multi-channel approach (email, social, calling) to proactively outreach to new leads within target accounts; our top SDRs are confident and effective on the phone Use Salesforce and Grafana dashboards for lead and account management and research Use research and data to prioritize and customize outreach to target prospects and accounts via email and LinkedIn Drive effective discovery conversations to understand users’ needs and goals in to provide them the appropriate resources and communicate how Grafana can help them  Consistently meet new business opportunity and pipeline targets Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as marketing and sales to win as a team What Makes You a Great Fit: Located in Austin, TX Open to feedback and coaching, always looking for ways to improve  Clear and concise written and verbal communication style Excellent organizational skills and the ability to prioritize many tasks and demands Willingness and ability to take on any task - no matter how small or big - with a focus on quality Resourceful and proactive in an environment that is constantly evolving Driven by purpose and by winning with a team-first attitude Bonus Points For:   Let’s be honest - interviewing is not easy. However, we want you to come prepared and succeed. When we interview, we’re trying to determine a couple of things: Would you be successful if you were part of our team? Will you love working here and be a positive influence on your fellow colleagues? Will you grow professionally and personally during your time here? We’re looking for people who are curious and passionate about technology, so make sure you invest some time in learning about Grafana Labs. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. About the Role This position is 100% remote and will be based in the United States and Canada. The Pipeline Programs Manager turns GitLab's pipeline targets into programs the field can run. You'll own execution of pipeline generation programs, including sales plays, PipeGen days, and run the hygiene checkpoints that keep pipeline data trustworthy. You'll also help surface the risks and upside behind our pipeline plan working across Sales, Marketing, Field Enablement, Sales Strategy, and RevOps.  What You'll Do Execute global and regional pipeline generation programs, including codified sales plays and PipeGen days, against an established program calendar. Coordinate in-quarter program delivery across regions and segments: timelines, owners, communications, and follow-through on action items. Run weekly, monthly, and quarterly pipeline hygiene checkpoints, and report on adherence and trends with RevOps and Sales Strategy. Partner with Marketing and Enablement to bring pipeline generation programs to the field with the right messaging, content, and training. Work with the team on the GTM plan by identifying the drivers, risks, and upside that could move the pipeline numbers, and making them visible to decision-makers. Give input on the design of sales plays, hygiene standards, and related incentives from what you see during execution. Track program performance against success measures, and summarize what worked, what didn't, and what to change next time. Coordinate global outbound program execution with Sales Development and sales leaders, and help bring it to regional and team levels at scale. Identify process and systems improvements in Salesforce and reporting that increase metric visibility and reduce manual work, and work with RevOps and Systems to land them. What You'll Bring 5+ Years experience in Sales, Sales Programs, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Field or Sales Enablement, or Marketing Operations, with a record of delivering programs on time and with quality. Experience running cross-functional programs with operational rigor: multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and clear follow-through. Comfort working with pipeline data. You can use Salesforce and BI dashboards to spot gaps and explain what they mean. Basic SQL (Snowflake or similar) is a plus. Understanding of the B2B sales funnel: pipeline creation, conversion, velocity, and hygiene. Clear communication and presentation skills. You can explain a program or a risk to Sales leaders and to cross-functional partners. Ability to influence without authority, earning trust and moving work forward across teams you don't manage. Good judgment in a fast-moving environment. You move quickly, keep quality high, and know when to escalate. Curiosity about how AI and automation can improve go-to-market execution. Ownership mindset. You carry programs through to outcomes, not just activity. Experience in a quota-carrying or sales role is a plus. About the Team The Pipeline Excellence team builds the pipeline engine that turns GitLab's growth targets into predictable, repeatable revenue outcomes. We set pipeline targets and the GTM plan, run the programs and cadence that keep the field moving, and turn pipeline data into recommendations on where to invest. We work with Speed with Quality, so our cadence and standards let go-to-market teams move fast without sacrificing forecast accuracy. We hold an Ownership Mindset, meaning every stage of the funnel has a defined owner and standard. We measure ourselves on Customer Outcomes: pipeline health exists to drive real bookings and real customer relationships, not just activity. We work closely with Sales leadership, Sales Strategy, Marketing, Field Enablement, Sales Development, Finance, and Analytics, and we're scaling that engine for the agentic era. Who we are We're Jobtome ( https://weare.jobtome.com/ ) — an HR Tech company building the modern web applications that companies use to run complex hiring and recruitment workflows at scale. Our products are highly interactive, data-driven, and built for real-world usage — not demos. We work with a strong product mindset, short feedback loops, and a pragmatic engineering culture: quality, ownership, and code we're still proud of a year from now. The role You'll join our engineering team as a Senior Go Backend Developer and take real ownership of critical backend systems and services — not ticket-pushing, actual ownership. Quick reminder before the details 5+ years of production Go experience — required Based in a European timezone (UTC−1 to UTC+3) What you'll do Design, build, and maintain backend services written in Go Build and evolve APIs (GraphQL and/or REST) behind complex product workflows Design scalable, reliable, and maintainable backend architectures Work closely with frontend engineers, product managers, data engineers, and designers Contribute to data modeling, business logic, and performance optimization Review code and take part in architectural and technical discussions Raise the bar on code quality, testing, observability, and system resilience Actively tackle refactoring, technical debt, and long-term improvements Own backend features end to end, from design to production Take part in Agile ceremonies (planning, stand-ups, retrospectives) Our stack Go sits at the center of everything.
